name: ZAX.I
source:
You wake up in darkness. A number on your hand slowly counts down. What will happen when it reaches zero?

[From [url=https://kairumagames.itch.io/zax-i]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在黑暗中醒来。手背上的一串数字正缓缓倒数。当数字归零的那一刻，究竟会发生什么？
